verdict.rationale: Smithery runs a registry with first-party discovery features. The CLI provides `smithery mcp search` for servers and `smithery tool find` for searching tools by name or intent. Published servers also get dedicated pages where users can discover, try, and install them, and an independent scan of the 'top 100 servers' corroborates a sizable catalog. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on capability or category filtering in the web catalog, a first-party statement of catalog size, and hands-on corroboration of search quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent

citations.quote: smithery mcp search [term]              # Search the Smithery registry
smithery tool find [query]             # Search tools by name or intent
Get a dedicated server page where users can discover, try, and install your MCP from any client
Scanned the top 100 servers on Smithery's registry
